name: Mercury Systems, Inc.
blurb: Mercury Systems, Inc. is a technology company that manufactures and sells components, products, modules, and subsystems for defense prime contractors, original equipment manufacturers, government, and commercial aerospace companies. Its offerings include power amplifiers, filters, oscillators, embedded processing boards, and memory devices. The company serves the aerospace and defense industry and is headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts.
recent: As of May 6, 2026, Mercury Systems stock closed at $91.66, up 10.49% on the day, with a market cap of $5.50 billion. The company reported revenue of $966.95 million over the trailing twelve months, with a net loss of $14.10 million. The 52-week range is $44.01 to $103.84.
